risks.risk: Rust/staining on the lower front could indicate water leakage, poor drainage, or corrosion that may affect longevity.
risks.proof: One close-up photo of the rust area plus a short clip showing the machine running a full cycle and draining (or a leak test with a small water fill).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used unit with possible cosmetic/maintenance issues (worst case: treat as not fully proven to be problem-free).

risks.risk: “No fault” not proven remotely—could have issues like weak spin, drainage problems, unusual noise, or error codes.
risks.proof: Power-on video showing the display/program selection and a short wash+spin segment (or error-code check).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested risk (worst case for safety: assume it may need service).

risks.risk: Motor claim (“never opened”) can’t be verified from the outside; internal repairs could have been done.
risks.proof: Photo of the motor/under-panel area if accessible, or a technician inspection report; alternatively a video showing no tampering marks where service would occur.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used (not guaranteed original/unopened).

risks.risk: Exact model/serial not confirmed; warranty/compatibility can’t be verified.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating/model/serial plate (usually on the door frame or back panel) with readable text.
risks.if_unproven: Price without warranty confidence (worst case: no warranty value).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the model/serial rating plate (readable).
Send a short video of the machine running: start a cycle, show the display, then show draining and spin.
Send close-ups of the rust/staining area and confirm whether there is any current leak (clip while running).
Show the receipt and warranty card (photos with dates/serial matching the machine).
response.reason: The item identity (LG DirectDrive 7kg) is readable, but key value drivers—working condition, leak/corrosion cause, and warranty proof—are not verifiable from the single photo. Without a power-on/drain/spin test, pricing could be wrong.
